description.content: Listings APIs enable a seller to programmatically sell on StockX. The APIs enable a user to  create, update and delete listings on the marketplace, as well as view and fetch live market data for any live or expired listings you have

Create listings API allows you to create new listings.
The listings correspond to an ask in the StockX UI. The listings can be for the same variant ID.
